---
title: Meta dotted lookup
format: html
custom:
  nested:
    value: deep-val
top: top-val
flag: false
authors:
  - Ada
  - Grace
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ["META\\[top-val\\]", "META\\[deep-val\\]", "META-NIL", "CHAIN\\[deep-val\\]", "BOOL\\[false\\]", "META\\[Grace\\]"]
---

Top: {{< getmeta top >}}

Dotted: {{< getmeta custom.nested.value >}}

Absent: {{< getmeta no-such-key >}}

Chained: {{< chainmeta >}}

Boolean: {{< boolmeta >}}

Array index: {{< getmeta authors.2 >}}
